facts.text: e2e.sh enables the set -euo pipefail shell options before it starts tracing every command with set -x.
e2e.sh expects the Release build at src/Dossier/bin/Release/net10.0/Dossier.dll under the repo root.
e2e.sh exits 1 with a dotnet build hint when the Release Dossier.dll is absent.
e2e.sh makes a temp directory, exports DOSSIER_DB to dossier.db inside it, and deletes that directory on EXIT.
e2e.sh runs scripts/seed.sh and scrapes the subjects_created and facts_created values out of its stdout.
e2e.sh exits 1 when the --descendants compile emits no more facts than the plain compile.
e2e.sh searches Memos/Home for composer with --limit 100 and echoes the total it parses from the JSON.
e2e.sh compiles Memos/Home at depth full in markdown and prints the whole document.
e2e.sh prints the compiled markdown from the Conflicts heading onward to show the seeded contradictions.
e2e.sh compiles Memos/Home markdown with --need billing invoice and --need webhook signature, then prints the Gaps section.
e2e.sh dumps scripts/seed/notes.md twice with --split heading and echoes created and deduped counts from both responses.
e2e.sh counts correlate proposals by grepping the JSON output for every fact_id occurrence.
count_json_array increments its counter once for every comma it strips from the array body.
count_json_array returns 0 when the array body is the empty string after its brackets are stripped.
array_field pulls the first compact array value for a named field out of one-line JSON with sed.
seed.sh defaults DOSSIER_DB to dossier.db at the repo root when the variable is unset.
seed.sh runs dotnet init against the resolved DLL before posting any file.
seed.sh reads the first attachment sha256 from memos.json and exits 1 when none is declared.
seed.sh hashes with shasum -a 256 when present, else sha256sum, and exits 1 when neither exists.
seed.sh exits 1 when the shot PNG hashes to a value other than the declared sha256.
seed.sh copies the shot PNG to blobs/<declared sha256> next to the database before posting.
seed.sh rehashes the stored blob and exits 1 when it does not match the declared sha256.
seed.sh posts memos-root.json and exits 1 when the response carries no subject id.
at: seed root post returned no subject id

facts.text: seed.sh rewrites each child file's subject.parent to the root id with jq and posts it through stdin.
seed.sh's record helper counts created subjects and facts whose status is new, then prints both counts to stderr.
seed.sh prints subjects_created and facts_created as its two stdout summary lines.
publish-demo.sh exits with seed.sh's own status after replaying the captured seed log on stderr.
publish-demo.sh changes to the repo root and publishes a relative --out so the recorded command stays portable.
publish-demo.sh prints files and bytes by counting every file in the output bundle and concatenating them.
publish-profile-demo.sh publishes against profiles/copilot-studio.json as its consumer profile.
publish-profile-demo.sh takes the output directory as its first argument, defaulting to examples/django-shards.
publish-profile-demo.sh exits 1 when the source bundle lacks manifest.json or a subjects directory.
publish-profile-demo.sh takes the dash bullets under the Facts heading of each subject's index.md as its fact lines.
publish-profile-demo.sh posts the per-subject JSON files four at a time with xargs -P 4.
publish-profile-demo.sh prints the profile table for a plain bundle and then for the --respect-limits shards.
publish-profile-demo.sh reports files, bytes, shards, smallest_shard_bytes and largest_shard_bytes for the output.
verify-refs.sh splits each target into an owner/repo prefix and the remaining file path.
verify-refs.sh builds the fetch URL as raw.githubusercontent.com with the repo, rev and relative path segments.
verify-refs.sh fetches each URL with curl, a 30 second timeout, and reads back http_code and size_download.
verify-refs.sh records a curl transport error as status 000 with zero bytes.
verify-refs.sh zeroes the byte count and increments fail whenever the status is not 200.
verify-refs.sh prints status, the first 10 characters of rev, bytes and path for every ref it tries.
verify-refs.sh appends the full target to the resolved file only when the fetch returned 200.
verify-refs.sh exits 1 when any git ref failed to resolve.
verify-refs.sh collects the target and rev of every git ref in the seed JSON files and reduces them with sort -u.
verify-refs.sh exits 1 when it finds no git refs in the seed JSON files.
scaling.sh posts every synthetic fact to the single subject Scaling/Corpus.
scaling.sh builds corpora of 50, 200 and 1000 facts, one database per size in the temp directory.
scaling.sh prints a settings line naming budget, strict mode, full depth, markdown format and the chars/4 estimator.
scaling.sh generates each fact text from a zero-padded index repeated across the alpha, beta, gamma and delta words.
scaling.sh estimates tokens by adding 3 to the character count and dividing by 4.
scaling.sh counts emitted facts by tallying dash lines up to the first level-two heading of the compiled file.
scaling.sh compiles each corpus with --budget 1200 in strict budget mode at full depth.
scaling.sh prints n/a for the ratio when the dossier token count is zero.
memos.json posts its facts to the subject Memos/Home with kind screen and the alias Home.
memos.json's first audit fact gives the Home header a headerHeight of 64 pixels.
memos.json's second audit fact gives the same Home header a headerHeight of 72 pixels.
memos.json states composerMaxRows 6 for the Home composer in one fact and composerMaxRows 12 in the next.
memos.json records a saveShortcut of Cmd+Enter on macOS and Ctrl+Enter on Windows and Linux.
memos.json's list fact carries two fact refs whose targets are the local ids at-sign hdr and at-sign cmp.
memos.json links Home to Memos/MemoDetail with a leads_to subject ref and to Memos/Archived the same way.
memos.json's shot fact declares a 70-byte image/png attachment whose sha256 starts 938cef59.
memos.json's git refs pin rev e4f3fb2d2d114f6eaea6ec75a10b0a274f57a8a1.
memos-root.json declares the Memos subject with kind app and the alias Memos App.
memos-root.json's route fact lists the web client routes /, /explore, /archived, /settings and /m/:id.
memos-signin.json's element fact describes a username field, a password field and a submit button.
at: Sign in screen has a username field

facts.text: memos-memodetail.json says the delete action removes the memo only after a confirmation.
at: The delete action removes the memo after a confirmation.

facts.text: memos-archived.json says the archived screen's restore action sends a memo back to the home list.
at: Restoring an archived memo sends it back to the home list.

facts.text: notes.md's Home screen section says that screen hosts the composer, the memo list and the header.
at: The home screen hosts the composer, the memo list, and the header.
